objective: Milestone 7: Discovery Queries, Multi-Opportunity Extraction and Data Retention Sweeper

tasks.description: Implement automated bilingual (EN/ZH) scholarship discovery query generator for target academic institutions, degree tiers, and disciplines (smart manufacturing, robotics) with negative-term filtering and syntax formatting.
acceptance_criteria: generateDiscoveryQueries(options) builds structured search query strings across targeted dimensions (institution, degree, discipline, intake year)
Generates bilingual queries supporting English and Chinese terms (e.g. 'smart manufacturing', '智能制造', 'robotics', '机器人', 'scholarship', '奖学金')
Applies negative search filters to prune noise (e.g. -consultancy, -agents, -commercial, -recruitment)
Supports operator-configurable search provider targets (Google, Bing, Baidu) with appropriate syntax modifiers (e.g. site:edu.cn, filetype:html)
Returns structured query objects with unique ID, query text, intended search engine target, priority weight, and metadata tags
Enforces bounded query list sizing and input parameter validation
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/discovery-queries.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement multi-opportunity listing and table parser for aggregated directory and listing HTML pages, extracting individual opportunity records, deadlines, and direct apply links without row cross-contamination.
acceptance_criteria: extractMultipleOpportunities(html, baseUrl, options) parses aggregated HTML tables, lists, or card layouts containing multiple scholarship programs or degree offerings
Extracts structured candidate records with title, deadline text, funding level/type, host university, and resolved absolute URL
Prevents cross-contamination across adjacent table rows or sibling card elements
Enforces URL normalization and same-host or academic subdomain validation against baseUrl
Handles missing or partial fields gracefully with fallbacks and extraction confidence scoring
Enforces bounded limits for input length and max extracted opportunities per document
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/multi-extractor.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement automated data lifecycle retention sweeper to enforce GDPR and operational storage retention policies (FR09), purging delivery logs older than 90 days, evidence snapshots older than 180 days, and expired ephemeral tokens, operating transactionally with audit logging.
acceptance_criteria: executeRetentionSweep(sql, options) identifies and purges expired records according to configured retention windows (delivery logs > 90d, evidence snapshots > 180d, expired session/auth tokens > 30d)
Executes deletions transactionally (or in bounded batches) to prevent table locks and database degradation
Generates a structured sweep report detailing record counts deleted per table and duration
Preserves referential integrity and avoids breaking active foreign keys
Dry-run mode (dryRun: true) supported to inspect candidates without mutating the database
Verifies operator authority or automated job authentication before execution
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/retention-sweeper.test.ts && npm run typecheck
